newsitem.title: UK: Portugal to buy up to eight cargoes of heavy fuel.
newsitem.headline: Portugal to buy up to eight cargoes of heavy fuel.

text.p: Portugal's state power company Electridade de Portugal (EdP) has tendered to buy up to eight cargoes of heavy fuel oil for delivery in September and October, trade sources said.

The tender calls for delivery of six high sulphur fuel oil cargoes into Lisbon and Setubal in September and two further optional cargoes in October but details of timing were not immediately available.
The cargoes are between 20,000 and 25,000 tonnes in size. EdP's original tender for August called for six cargoes but the company bought a further one cargo last week.
